sentences.en: From 7 o'clock onwards, the traffic in the town picks up.
sentences.zh: 从早上7点开始，镇上的交通就会逐渐增多。

sentences.en: From next week onwards Jane will take responsibility for our students.
sentences.zh: 从下周开始，简将负责我们的学生。

sentences.en: We've made it to Berlin, onwards to New York.
sentences.zh: 我们已经到达了柏林，接下来我们将前往纽约。
